description: Call before shipping one product that bundles code, data, fonts or media under different licenses. Checks 2-25 SPDX ids against each other for your intended use (default: redistribution) and returns compatible, needs_review or incompatible, with the reason for every pair, the combined duties and which license governs the result. Free, no key. Call with {"licenses": ["MIT", "GPL-3.0-only", "CC-BY-NC-4.0"], "intended_use": {"redistribution": true, "commercial_use": true}}.

intended_use.description: Intended use. Every true flag is a right the assessment must find documented; omitted flags are false. Unknown fields are refused (invalid_intended_use). For instance {"commercial_use":true,"deployment":true,"attribution_planned":true,"duration_days":365}

duration_days.description: Whole days of use (1 to 36500), or null for no fixed term

geography.description: worldwide (default) or a region code such as US, EU, UK

name: license_compatibility
title: Can these licenses be combined?
